messages:
maria.h: Quick sync — proposing a small audit payload cleanup. Plan is to remove legacy fields (session_token, raw_request_body), add an explicit `event_version` envelope, and offer KMS-wrapped actor ids for customers who need PII protection. Need strategy for versioning, migration windows, SDK/client validation, and KMS/key-rotation implications. Thoughts?

ajohnson: Do we have an inventory of consumers that still read `session_token`? Breaking those silently will be bad.

maria.h: Good point. I started a quick consumer scan but we should do a safer dual-write. Proposal: emit `event_version:1` for old shape and `event_version:2` for new shape in parallel for 30d, then switch to only v2 for 60d canary, then deprecate v1 after 90d.

devon: Can you paste a before/after sample? :eyes:

maria.h: Sample payloads below. The idea is to keep the event compact and explicit about version.

maria.h: ```json
// v1 (current)
{
  "event_type": "auth.login",
  "actor_id": "user:123",
  "session_token": "eyJ...",
  "raw_request_body": "{\"ip\":\"1.2.3.4\"}",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-03T18:23:00Z"
}
```

maria.h: ```json
// v2 (proposed)
{
  "event_version": 2,
  "event_type": "auth.login",
  "actor_id": "user:123",
  "actor_id_hash": "sha256:abc123...",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-03T18:23:00Z"
}
```

samir: We can't send raw actor ids for regulated customers. Suggest we either: 1) include `actor_id_hash` (sha256) or 2) `actor_id_kms_ref` + encrypted blob. KMS option needs a `kms_key_id` header to support rotation.

natalie: Agree. Also note KMS will change exportability of events (exported audit bundles must include key metadata or a signed mapping file). For customer-facing validation, we can provide a signed attestation document that maps hashes to customer-provided identities if they opt in.

devon: SDK impact: clients need an adapter that tolerates both shapes. We'll add `audit.parseEvent()` helper that reads `event_version` or falls back to known fields. We should publish a compatibility matrix and minor-version bump.

ajohnson: Recommend canary: enable v2-only in a small subset of internal services, then Dedicated customers who opt into early upgrades. Add telemetry metric `audit.event.parse_errors` and alert if >0.1% failures.

maria.h: Proposed rollout steps: 1) RFC and consumer inventory (1 week). 2) Dual-write (v1+v2) with telemetry (30 days). 3) Canary flip to v2-only for opt-in customers + internal services (30 days). 4) Deprecation notice + 60d window. 5) Remove v1 support after 180 days from RFC.

samir: For KMS: we need to decide whether we store encrypted actor blobs in the event or only references. Storing blobs increases payload size. Reference implies we must maintain a lookup service — ops cost.

natalie: Also consider RBAC change: audit-read role should be allowed to see hashed ids, but only `audit-privileged` may decrypt. Need to update console export and per-customer key bindings.

devon: I'll add unit tests and a replay harness to validate consumers — replays v1->v2 and compares downstream behaviour. We should also add a contract test suite for third-party consumers.

ajohnson: Created tickets for consumer outreach and SDK work?

inc-bot: Created SEC-3456: "audit field sunset + v2 migration plan" <https://tickets.example.com/SEC-3456>

samir: I'll draft KMS impact doc and include key-rotation examples.

maria.h: Thanks all — I'll write the RFC today and share the rollout doc. Please drop any consumer names you know into SEC-3456. :thumbsup:
